comments:
Canvas State — Complete state management for infinite canvas.

## Design Philosophy

Canvas state is a **pure data structure** that combines:

- **Viewport state**: Pan, zoom, visible bounds (from Schema.Graph.Viewport)
- **Gesture state**: Active gestures, touch tracking (from Schema.Gestural)
- **Selection state**: Selected objects, anchor point
- **Tool state**: Current tool, tool-specific state
- **Interaction state**: Hover, drag, focus
- **History state**: Undo/redo stack

## Event-Driven Model

Canvas does NOT poll or animate continuously. State changes via:

1. User input (pointer, touch, keyboard)
2. External data changes
3. Timer/animation completion

Each event produces a new CanvasState. The runtime diffs and patches.

## Gesture Integration

All gesture types from Schema.Gestural are supported:

- **Pointer**: Mouse, touch, pen with pressure/tilt
- **Gestures**: Tap, LongPress, Swipe, Pan, Pinch, Rotate
- **DragDrop**: Full drag lifecycle with transfer data
- **Keyboard**: Keys, modifiers, shortcuts

## Dependencies

- Schema.Graph.Viewport (viewport state)
- Schema.Gestural.* (all gesture types)
- Composition.Trigger (event system)
- Canvas.Types (canvas-specific types)

declarations.comments:
Complete canvas state.

This is the single source of truth for the canvas component.
All operations produce a new CanvasState (immutable).
declarations.title: CanvasState

declarations.comments:
History entry for undo/redo.

Stores enough state to restore canvas to a previous point.
declarations.title: HistoryEntry

declarations.comments: Reset canvas to initial state, preserving config.
declarations.title: resetCanvasState

declarations.comments: Pan to absolute position (in canvas coordinates).
declarations.title: panTo

declarations.comments: Zoom to fit all objects in view.
declarations.title: zoomToFit

declarations.comments: Zoom to fit selection in view.
declarations.title: zoomToSelection

declarations.comments: Select all objects within a rectangle (in canvas coordinates).
declarations.title: selectInRect

declarations.comments:
Add an object to the canvas.

New objects are added at the end (highest z-index by array position).
declarations.title: addObject

declarations.comments: Remove an object from the canvas by ID.
declarations.title: removeObject

declarations.comments:
Update an object by ID.

If the object doesn't exist, state is unchanged.
declarations.title: updateObject

declarations.comments: Current interaction mode determines how input is interpreted.
declarations.title: InteractionMode

declarations.comments: Check if any object is being hovered.
declarations.title: hasHoveredObject

declarations.comments: Check if Meta (Cmd on Mac, Win on Windows) is held.
declarations.title: isMetaHeld

declarations.comments: Check if any modifier is held.
declarations.title: hasAnyModifier

declarations.comments: Get the last pressed key code (if any).
declarations.title: lastPressedKey

declarations.comments:
Push current state to history.

Uses cons (prepend) for O(1) stack operations.
Most recent entry is at the head of the array.
declarations.title: pushHistory

declarations.comments:
Undo last action.

Pops from undo stack (head) and pushes current state to redo stack.
declarations.title: undo

declarations.comments:
Redo last undone action.

Pops from redo stack (head) and pushes current state to undo stack.
declarations.title: redo

declarations.comments: Get objects visible in current viewport.
declarations.title: visibleObjects

declarations.comments: Check if a specific object is visible.
declarations.title: isObjectVisible

declarations.comments: Convert screen coordinates to canvas coordinates.
declarations.title: screenToCanvas

declarations.comments: Convert canvas coordinates to screen coordinates.
declarations.title: canvasToScreen

declarations.comments: Get total number of objects on canvas.
declarations.title: objectCount

declarations.comments: Get undo stack depth (for UI display).
declarations.title: undoStackDepth

declarations.comments: Get redo stack depth (for UI display).
declarations.title: redoStackDepth

declarations.comments:
Get object at specific index in the objects array.

Index 0 is the first object. Returns Nothing if out of bounds.
declarations.title: objectAtIndex

declarations.comments:
Check if zoom percentage is within a specific range.

Useful for UI state (e.g., showing different controls at different zoom levels).
declarations.title: isZoomInRange

declarations.comments:
Get debug info about canvas state.

Returns a human-readable string summarizing the current state.
Useful for development and debugging.
declarations.title: stateDebugInfo
